tags.note: v1.12 tag icons: draw left of the TEST / title / WANTED tag text at stage scale / unit

coinFlip.note: big: a 32-frame turn of the Dollah (frame 0 = heads / Sky, 16 = tails / Cosmic Trinity); land by easing the frame to 0 or 16. small: the coin a character flicks (draw at its hand anchor, rising and falling).

vehicles.note: CONTRACTS v1.10: draw vehicleOf(spec, kind) parts in `order`; a body / hull part is drawn at the vehicle origin, wheels at body meta.wheels (minus wheel meta.centre), the decal at body meta.panel; the rider (the character, side view) with its head anchor at the body meta.seat (car) / vehicles.ufo.seat, clipped below riderClip; everything bobs by bob[state][frame] px. Recolour parts with the worn colours exactly like items.

auras.note: v1.22: draw parts[spec.extras.aura.item].rects[frame] (frame = ⌊t·fps⌋ mod frames) at ox/oy in the actor's 128×128 frame BEFORE every layer (behind the character), moved down with the height rows like the feet; recolour through the mask with spec.extras.aura.colors like an item. Not mirrored.

pets.note: draw parts[spec.pet.item][anim|dir] at the pet ground anchor (side faces right, mirror for left); recolour with spec.pet.colors like an item

nameTags.note: CONTRACTS v1.18: draw shapes[spec.tag.shape] as a 9-slice around the name (slice px kept, the uniform middle row / column stretched by whole pixels; scaling or repeating it is identical), text box = pad inset; mask:true shapes are recoloured with spec.tag.colors[0] via maskAtlas (core recolour, channel 1); a tail is drawn centred under the box, `overlap` px up. Name pixels take colors[spec.tag.name] (see kinds), glyphs from fonts[spec.tag.font]. Draw everything at whole-pixel scale, never smoothed.
nameTags.colorKinds: solid: hex[0] · glow: hex[0] text + a 1-px hex[1] halo around the glyphs, alpha pulsing 0.35–0.85 at speed pulses/s · gradient: hex stops left→right over the text width · glitter: hex[0] with ~7% of pixels flashing hex[1] and ~6% hex[2], re-rolled speed times/s · rainbow: hex stops cycled along x (one cycle per 48 px) and time (speed cycles/s) · shimmer: hex[0] (bottom 40% hex[2]) with a diagonal hex[1] highlight (3 px, plus 2 px of the hex[0]/hex[1] mix each side) sweeping across speed times/s

fonts.note: CONTRACTS v1.18: white bitmap glyphs, cell [w,h] in a grid of `cols` per row in `chars` order (ASCII 32–126); glyph i at ((i % cols)·w, ⌊i / cols⌋·h), drawn left-aligned, then advance[char] px (glyph width + 1-px spacing). baseline = rows above the baseline (descenders below). Tint with the name colour; integer scale only.

fight.note: v1.18: start the defender's hit reaction on strikes[anim].contact; place the attacker so anchorX + reach[prop] ≈ defender anchorX − headFront[prop] (facing each other; the defender in hitLight frame 0) — the glove lands on the face. headFront is the human head; for other species use metrics[variant].side.bbox (right edge − anchor). bodyFront = the chest front in the guard. Art px; ÷ frame.unit × stage scale. Mirrored (facing left): negate.

palettes.note: body layers: ch1 = spec.skin (or breed[0]), ch2/ch3 = these; cats and dogs use the breed palette for all three

metrics.note: v1.16 body metrics: bare character (body + head + tail + default ears/coat; no clothes, hair, hats, wings) at idle frame 0, art px in frame coordinates (ground anchor = frame.anchor). headTop includes ears / horns / antennae. height = anchor y - headTop (short); add heightAdd[spec.height]. radius = collision radius. hats[id] = px a hat adds above the bare head top; wings[id] = wing extent (dragon 1.average).
